pages.text: Wants a room: walls, a floor and a ceiling, with no way out to the sky. At least 27 blocks of space.$(p)Grants:$(li)Knockback resistance, growing with the tier, up to +15%%.$(p)Tiers begin at a score of 6.

Will not count without:$(li)1 of Zombie Head or Skeleton Skull or Creeper Head or Piglin Head or Wither Skeleton Skull or Dragon Head or Player Head$(p)Rewards, most first:$(li)Dragon Head$(li)Wither Skeleton Skull$(li)Piglin Head$(li)Creeper Head$(li)Player Head$(p)Counts against it:$(li)any crops$(li)$(l:soulhome:multiblocks/tags#smithing)any smithing$(/l)
